content.trans: 英语：特殊商品有特定的关税。

content.text: For example, if I want to come to America and I have three bottles of wine,
content.trans: 例如，如果我想要去美国，并且有三瓶葡萄酒，请问你打算如何处理这些酒？

content.text: I have to give one away because I'm only allowed to bring in two bottles.
content.trans: 我必须把这瓶水送给你们，因为只允许带一瓶。

content.text: Right.
content.trans: 正确。以下是“right”在中文中的翻译：

content.text: So I have to declare two bottles of wine or money.
content.trans: 所以，我必须宣布一瓶酒或一串钱。

content.text: I'm only allowed to bring $10,000.
If I bring $15,000, I have to write that down and say I have this extra money.
content.trans: 如果我带了15万元，我必须写这个钱下来，并说我已经有了这额外的钱。

content.text: And then I pay tax.
content.trans: 英语：然后我交税。

content.text: Right.
content.trans: 右。

content.text: So basically they will ask you what are you bringing to America?
content.trans: 所以基本上他们将问你要带什么来美国吗？

content.text: And if there are special things like money or things you will sell or alcohol cigarettes,
content.trans: 如果有一些特别的东西，比如钱或你将要出售的物品或者酒精香烟，

content.text: you have to declare these.
content.trans: 你必须把这些文件提交给我。

content.text: You have to explain what you're carrying.
content.trans: 你必须解释你正在携带的东西。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: So this is a very important question also.
content.trans: 所以这也是一个非常重要的问题。

content.text: Most of the time, obviously if you're on tourism,
content.trans: 大多数情况下，如果你在旅游时，

content.text: you don't have much to declare.
content.trans: 你没有什么要说的。

content.text: But maybe like if Catherine says,
content.trans: 但是或许如果凯特拉说，

content.text: maybe you are going to buy a house in the United States and you have $20,000 in your luggage,
content.trans: 英语：也许你打算在美国买一套房子，并且你的行李中有$20,000。

content.text: then you need to tell them that.
content.trans: 然后你得告诉他们。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: So that's called declaring to declare at customs.
content.trans: 所以，这就是叫交验到海关的程序。

content.text: All right.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: So let's take a break and listen to our dialogue one last time.
content.trans: 所以，让我们暂停一下，听听我们的对话再聊一次。

content.text: Good afternoon passport and arrival card, please.
content.trans: 下午好护照和登机牌，请。

content.text: Here you are.
content.trans: 在这里。

content.text: Where are you coming from?
content.trans: 在哪儿？

content.text: China.
content.trans: 中国。

content.text: Is this your country of birth or residence?
content.trans: 是的，这是你的出生地还是居住地？

content.text: I just worked there.
content.trans: 我刚刚在这里工作。

content.text: What is the purpose of your visit to the United States?
content.trans: 英语：你来美国的目的是什么？

content.text: I'm here on vacation.
content.trans: 我在这里度假。

content.text: How long do you plan to stay in the United States?
content.trans: 英语：你打算在美国待多久？

content.text: Almost three weeks.
content.trans: 大约三个星期。

content.text: Sir, you didn't fill out the information on your arrival card of where you'll be staying.
content.trans: 亲爱的先生，你没有在你的入住卡上填写好你们将要居住的地方的信息。

content.text: Oh, I'm sorry, but there are a couple of different places that we'll travel to within the United States.
content.trans: 英语：哦，抱歉，但我们将前往美国的几个不同的地方。

content.text: So I wasn't sure what to put.
content.trans: 所以我不知道该放什么。

content.text: You must specify an address on the place where you will spend most of your time.
content.trans: 你必须在你要花费大部分时间的地方指定一个地址。

content.text: Okay.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: Here you are.
content.trans: 在这里。

content.text: Do you have enough means to support yourself while you're here?
content.trans: 是的，我有足够的能力来支持自己在这里。

content.text: Yes, I have some travelers checks and two credit cards.
content.trans: 是的，我有一些旅行卡和两张信用卡。

content.text: Very good.
content.trans: 非常棒。

content.text: Do you have anything to declare?
content.trans: 英语：你有什么要宣布的吗？

content.text: Nope.
content.trans: 不。

content.text: I only have my clothes and camera.
content.trans: 我只有我的衣服和相机。

content.text: Very well, sir.
content.trans: 很好，先生。

content.text: Welcome to the United States.
content.trans: 欢迎来到美国。

content.text: Enjoy your visit.
content.trans: 请欣赏您的访问。

content.text: All right, so when you're arriving to immigration, obviously all these questions are very, very common.
content.trans: 英语：一切好，所以当你到达移民局时，这些问题非常普遍。

content.text: You will be asked.
content.trans: 你将被要求。

content.text: But when you're arriving there, there are actually two different sections that you have to go to.
content.trans: 但是当你到达那里时，实际上有两个不同的部分需要你去到。

content.text: Right?
content.trans: 是的。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: There's two different lines.
content.trans: 英语：有两条不同的线。

content.text: You'll maybe many lines, but they'll have a sign on top.
content.trans: 英语：你可能会有很多条线，但上面会有标志。

content.text: One says US passports or US passport holders.
content.trans: 英语：一张美国护照或持有美国护照的人。

content.text: And that means the line for Americans coming home to America.
content.trans: 这句话的意思是“这意味着美国公民回家的线路。”

content.text: But for most people who are traveling to America, they're foreigners.
content.trans: 但是对于大多数去美国旅行的人，他们都是外国人。

content.text: They have to go to the other line.
content.trans: 他们必须下到另一条线上。

content.text: So that's non-US passport holders.
content.trans: 所以，这是非美国护照持有人。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: Now remember that you don't really have to get nervous when you're talking to the immigration officer.
content.trans: 现在记得，你不必因为和移民官交谈而感到紧张。

content.text: You know, just have to take it easy and just try to answer the questions.
content.trans: 英语：你知不知道，就先试试回答这些问题吧。

content.text: Most of them will speak a couple of words in many popular languages like Chinese or Spanish or Arabic.
content.trans: 大多数人都会说几种流行的语言，比如中文、西班牙语或阿拉伯语。

content.text: Because obviously some people that go on holiday to the United States, maybe they don't speak English.
content.trans: 因为显然一些去美国度假的人，可能不会说英语。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: So there's nothing to be worried about.
content.trans: 所以没有什么要担心的。

content.text: These people are there to make sure that America is safe.
content.trans: 这些人在确保美国安全。

content.text: They want to check the bags.
content.trans: 他们想检查包。

content.text: They want to know who who's coming into the country.
content.trans: 他们想知道谁将进入该国。

content.text: And they're just doing their job being, being basically policing the borders.
content.trans: 英语：他们只是在做他们的工作，基本上是在监控边境。

content.text: Right.
content.trans: 正确。以下是该短语的中文翻译：

content.text: But it's pretty simple.
content.trans: 但是它挺简单的。

content.text: The most annoying part of custom for me is waiting in line.
content.trans: 英语：点和拍是傻瓜相机，SLR/DSLR是单反相机，机身是体，镜头是镜，长焦是长焦，偏振镜是偏振镜，卸下重任是卸下任务，赋予神速是授予神速，远程且微弱是疏远且微弱，步骤下来是卸任，辞职信是辞职信，入门级是入门级，显示屏是显示屏，套机镜头是机，流利构建单元是单元，全球视野是全视场。

content.text: Yeah.
content.trans: 是。

content.text: You have so many people arrive at the same time that you can wait in line maybe an hour sometimes.
content.trans: 英语：你有这么多人同时到来，你可能需要排队至少一个小时。

content.text: Sometimes.
content.trans: 有时候。

content.text: So again, just be honest.
content.trans: 英语：所以，再次，请坦白。

content.text: And you know, I think people will try to understand you if you're having a hard time.
content.trans: 您知道，我认为人们会尽力理解你，如果你遇到困难。

content.text: Exactly.
content.trans: 正确翻译为中文是：“正好。”

content.text: So if you have any questions or comments, you can find us at EnglishPod.com.
content.trans: 英语：所以如果你有任何问题或评论，请找到我们在这里的英文论坛。

content.text: And we'll see you guys there.
content.trans: 我们将在那里见你。

content.text: Bye.
content.trans: 拜。
